fields.name: ArgentSeaOrleansReminderTable IReminderTable operations
fields.contract: ArgentSeaOrleansReminderTable provides an IReminderTable implementation for its selected shard set. It reads one reminder by grain and name, reads the reminders for one grain or a hash range, removes a named reminder conditionally using its version text, exposes a completed no-op test-clear operation, and upserts a reminder. A missing single-row result is represented by a ReminderEntry bearing the requested GrainId; a successful upsert returns the new row version as an invariant-culture string; removal returns whether the row was found.
